name: deCONZ-Community
description: This Docker image containerizes the deCONZ software from Dresden Elektronik, which controls a ZigBee network using a Conbee USB or RaspBee GPIO serial interface. This image runs deCONZ in "minimal" mode, for control of the ZigBee network via the WebUIs ("Wireless Light Control" and "Phoscon") and over the REST API and Websockets, and optionally runs a VNC server for viewing and interacting with the ZigBee mesh through the deCONZ UI. This template uses a custom ip - network type custom br:0 - (alternatively, you can use host and change the web ports) If you are migrating an existing marthoc/deconz install to deconzcommunity/deconz, Make sure you have the latest backup from the Phoscon. Enable advanced options to show more settings

variables.name: deCONZ Device
variables.description: Set same as device, if you forward a device by id, you don't need to change this

variables.name: Time Zone
variables.description: Set the local time zone so deCONZ has the correct time

variables.name: VNC Mode Enable/Disable
variables.description: Set this option to enable VNC access to the container to view the deCONZ ZigBee mesh: 1=Enable, 0=Disable

variables.name: VNC Port
variables.description: Port for VNC mode access to deCONZ application

variables.name: VNC password
variables.description: Default password for VNC mode is 'changeme', Make sure to change the default password if VNC is enabled

variables.name: noVNC Port
variables.description: Port for web access to view the deCONZ ZigBee mesh using noVNC, setting the port to `0` will disable the noVNC functionality

variables.name: Debug Info
variables.description: Sets the level of the deCONZ command-line flag --dbg-info

variables.name: Debug APS
variables.description: Sets the level of the deCONZ command-line flag --dbg-aps

variables.name: Debug ZCL
variables.description: Sets the level of the deCONZ command-line flag --dbg-zcl

variables.name: Debug ZDP
variables.description: Sets the level of the deCONZ command-line flag --dbg-zdp

variables.name: DEBUG DDF
variables.description: Sets the level of the deCONZ command-line flag --dbg-ddf

variables.name: Debug DEV
variables.description: Sets the level of the deCONZ command-line flag --dbg-dev

variables.name: Debug OTA
variables.description: Sets the level of the deCONZ command-line flag --dbg-ota

variables.name: Debug Error
variables.description: Sets the level of the deCONZ command-line flag --dbg-error

variables.name: Debug HTTP
variables.description: Sets the level of the deCONZ command-line flag --dbg-http

variables.name: deCONZ Start Verbose
variables.description: Set this option to 0 to disable verbose of start script, set to 1 to enable `set -x` logging

devices.name: Conbee USB Port
devices.description: Path to Conbee USB device, It is recommended to use serial by id: /dev/serial/by-id/usb-dresden_elektronik_ingenieurtechnik_GmbH_ConBee_II_[SN]-if00:/dev/ttyACM0
